veranderings.blok: Werk wat al honderde jare aanhou
veranderings.rede: As written, 'uit gras' can be read as applying to the clay pots too; the compound removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.

veranderings.voor: daarom maak baie wewers hulle klam
veranderings.na: daarom maak baie wewers die halms klam
veranderings.rede: Directly after 'baie wewers', 'hulle' can be read as the weavers themselves; naming the stalks makes the reference clear.
'Bo-op mekaar' is the natural Afrikaans for layers lying one on top of the other.

veranderings.voor: Klei is sag genoeg om te vorm
veranderings.na: Klei is sag genoeg om dit te vorm
veranderings.rede: 'Vorm' needs an object here; without 'dit' it can read as the clay forming by itself.
Two coordinate adjectives take a comma, as the lesson already does in 'gladde, ronde klippie'.
